headline: KC prop shares jump 50% on debt‑restructuring filing, leading market action
market_take: Today's coverage shows a mixed landscape: PF&REIT M‑STOR surged 26.85% while the PROP sector saw sharp declines in PF (-20.00%) and A (-13.86%). CONS stocks BKD and NL posted double‑digit intraday gains backed by massive volume spikes, whereas CONMAT experienced extreme gaps with PPP down -100.00% and DCON up +7.14% at open. Multiple REITs announced capital reductions, and TKN disclosed a new share‑repurchase programme, adding pressure on valuation.

BKD surged +10.62% with a 165.3σ volume spike and +9.65% intraday move; NL rose +9.84% on a 240.5σ volume spike; SOLAR slipped -7.69% intraday; TPOLY opened -10.00% and also filed a risk‑transaction notice.
